reason: I want to obtain local material for the paving, and using the shovel on the workshop ground seems like a natural first step.
expectation: I expect to gather or expose some local material, though I'm unsure what form it will take.

alternatives.reason: Combining the mesh with metal stock might make a screen for processing material, but gathering material first seems more direct.

effect: The shovel produced excavated regolith, giving me local material to process for paving.
reaction: That was a straightforward, satisfying first step.
reason: Making a screen seems useful for sorting the excavated material, and this is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect the mesh and metal stock to form a screen, though I don't yet know how it will be used.

effect: The mesh and stock made a sieve, which should let me sort the excavated regolith.
reaction: The result matched my expectation; it feels like a useful preparation.
reason: Sieving the regolith is the only offered combination and seems like the natural next step toward usable paving material.
expectation: I expect the sieve to separate the regolith by particle size, though I don't know what material the game will produce.

effect: The sieve produced a consistent fine feedstock, so the furnace can test it without the larger stones.
reaction: The explanation made the preparation feel purposeful.
reason: The furnace trial is the only offered combination and seems like the next step toward making paving.
expectation: I expect the furnace to heat the graded regolith into a ceramic material, though I don't know whether it will produce finished paving.

effect: The furnace made porous bricks after a slower firing cycle, and the next goal is to give the workshop a solid floor.
reaction: The failed first trial made the firing process more interesting and showed why the cycle mattered.
reason: Using the bricks on the workshop ground seems like the direct way to build the floor.
expectation: I expect to lay the bricks as a solid workshop floor, though I don't know whether any further preparation is needed.

alternatives.reason: The metal stock might help construct another useful structure from the bricks, but the floor is the current goal.

effect: The bricks became workshop paving, completing the floor goal and the chapter.
reaction: The detail of the workbench staying steady made the floor's practical value clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Firing the graded regolith was most worthwhile: the failed first trial and slower successful cycle showed that processing conditions mattered.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the sieve was useful, but the action itself was predictable and had little explanation until the material was sieved.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the first firing trial flaked and that a slower cycle produced sound, porous bricks.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each contributed clearly to making the floor.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the ceramic material helps make root beds and what the expedition builds next.
